existing_percent_code: Remains reserved for relative uncertainty/confidence metadata and specified-elongation descriptors;never added to central unit enum.

central_boundary.representations: Reuse existing closed scalar/interval/comparison shapes when explicitly source-supported;unbroken hyphens in this batch are not censored bounds.

absolute_uncertainty: Same percent_elongation code as central result;0.15 means an absolute SD/± amplitude in elongation-percentage points,not0.15percent relative error
relative_uncertainty: Existing reported_measures relative_to_reported_value uses old percent code and closed shape;confidence percentages unchanged. No conversion between absolute and relative statistics.
typed_target: specified_elongation forbidden on this result quantity;existing pressure-target descriptor unchanged
